Hello, I'm Chloe Jones! Currently I am a data science graduate student at Georgetown University (a far way from home), working toward my M.S. in Data Science and Analytics. Before moving to DC, I graduated in the spring of 2026 with a B.S. in Computer Science from Texas State University, with minors in Mathematics and Data Analytics. I also very proudly played soccer for Texas State University and won the conference championship my senior year!

My background is in applied machine learning: a sales enablement computer vision internship at Dell Technologies (2025), an AI/ML internship at Nokia (2026), and research on large-scale electronic health record data at Texas State (2024–2026).

## Education

- **2026:** Texas State University, B.S. in Computer Science
- **2027 (expected):** Georgetown University, M.S. in Data Science and Analytics
